reason: I already pay an admin to put receipts into Excel. It's slow, but it gets done. Half my spending is cash to mechanics with a handwritten nota or no paper at all, so a bot reading receipts won't see the money I actually worry about. I might throw the free 30 at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay for it this month.
objection: I can do this for free with Excel or Zoho, or build a bot myself. And the cash I hand mechanics mostly never turns into a receipt, so the report would look clean while the real leaks stay invisible.
would_change_my_mind: If the free run on my own chat found duplicate or inflated payments worth more than a few months of the subscription, like a part paid twice or a fuel amount that doesn't match, I'd pay.
